280-1479-8337.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, M'Ress, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and M'Ress trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2317-2438-7084-8345.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

1753-5078-6650-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
1753-5078-6650-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4302-5929-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4302-5929-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
4302-5929-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

628-3899-7195.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Chaos Spewer.
When Chaos Spewer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Chaos Spewer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

1116-2738-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sek'Kuar, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2957-3310-7855.notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on War Elemental.
2957-3310-7855.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing War Elemental to become a Goblin until end of turn.
Put a counter on War Elemental.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as War Elemental is a Goblin due to Imagecrafter, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4885-6006-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4661-4890.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4661-4890.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dack's Duplicate and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4661-4890.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2103-4428-7757-7758.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
2103-4428-7757-7758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Blink Shivan Sand-Mage using Thassa.
When Shivan Sand-Mage enters, it triggers, removing two time counters from Capture of Jingzhou.
Capture of Jingzhou's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1494-5435-7720-7737.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1887-3099-4565-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Ozolith, the Shattered Spire and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

3504-4004-7149.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Mercurial Pretender into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mercurial Pretender dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Mercurial Pretender enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Mercurial Pretender leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Mercurial Pretender from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-4766-7361.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more Spirits.
2438-4766-7361.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kodama.
When Kodama dies, its soulshift ability and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Kodama from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2463-3259-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2463-3259-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3110-3165-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3110-3165-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

703-803-4050-4394.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {1}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

2146-2866-3689-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

56-2523-4556-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-2523-4556-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Blight Mound and Ratadrabik of Urborg trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-2523-4556-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

190-389-5248-6036.description:
Activate The Book of Exalted Deeds by paying {W}{W}{W}, tapping and exiling it, putting an enlightened counter on an Angel you control.
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to The Book of Exalted Deeds.
Cast Cleansing Nova by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

1170-1414-4814-6020.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Mirrodin Besieged and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Mirrodin Besieged trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Trading Post.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Trading Post's third ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing the Myr token, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-3698-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-3698-5490.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Pith Driller trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1561-5850.notablePrerequisites:
Twenty-Toed Toad does not have summoning sickness.
Your deck size is at least 39, minus 2 for each card in your hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1561-5850.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw half your library and lose half your life total, rounded up.
Declare Twenty-Toed Toad as an attacker.
Twenty-Toed Toad's second ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

2959-3327-3719.notablePrerequisites:
Dargo is one of your commanders.
You have sacrificed a number of artifacts and/or creatures this turn equal to the number of times you've cast
2959-3327-3719.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure artifact tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}, creating a token copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When the Ruthless Technomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Ruthless Technomancer and create two Treasure artifact tokens.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Activate the Ruthless Technomancer token by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure artifact tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} and sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 8.

2896-3518-4393-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Dance of Many from your graveyard by paying {U}{U}.
When Dance of Many enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Muldrotha.
Put the nontoken Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Necromancy from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Necromancy attached to it.
Put the token Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Muldrotha token dies, Dance of Many's third ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dance of Many.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may cast any other permanent cards in your graveyard that are not solely enchantments and/or artifacts.

2348-2882-3819-5220-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two land cards in hand.
Infinite Reflection attached to Cultivator Colossus.
2348-2882-3819-5220-5256.description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield as a copy of Cultivator Colossus due to Nature's Revolt and Infinite Reflection.
When the land enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the land on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target opponent to mill cards equal to the land's power.
Resolve the land's trigger from step 3, causing you to put any other land onto the battlefield from your hand, draw a card, and then decline to put another land onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3430-3793-4222-4720.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Apprentice Wizard.
Apprentice Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
3430-3793-4222-4720.description:
Activate Apprentice Wizard by paying {U} and tapping it, adding nine {C}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

614-1987-2510-4792.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
614-1987-2510-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Nucklavee, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
